name: Aldren & Moss Classic Oxford
description: A full-brogue oxford in deep mahogany synth-leather with a hand-buffed finish that holds its shine through a full workday. The sole is thin-profile rubber with micro-tread, almost invisible from the side. Nothing flashy — just a very well-made shoe that signals you've been around long enough to know what good looks like.
functionality: Moisture-wicking lining, odor-resistant insole. No active tech.
what_it_says: You dress like someone with taste but not excess. Reliable, professional, not trying too hard.
story_hooks: A pair found in a dead man's locker — polished the morning he disappeared.
The manufacturer's subtle embossed logo is a known identifier for a specific corponation subsidiary tier.

physical_description.visual_profile: A classic oxford silhouette with subtle full-brogue perforations across the toe cap and quarters. Sits at mid-ankle height with a refined, slightly tapered toe box. The shoe projects understated competence—neither flashy nor utilitarian, but deliberately well-crafted. The hand-buffed mahogany finish catches light with a warm, deep luster that reads as expensive restraint.
physical_description.fit: Tailored and snug through the midfoot with a structured toe box that accommodates light augmentation without visible bulk. The heel cup is firm but not rigid, designed for prolonged wear during corporate or professional environments.
physical_description.primary_material: Deep mahogany synth-leather with a hand-buffed finish that mimics aged leather's patina development. The sole is thin-profile thermoplastic rubber engineered for grip without adding volume.
physical_description.texture: The leather surface is smooth with a subtle satin sheen from the buffing process. The brogue perforations create a delicate textural interplay where light plays across the holes. The sole has microscopic tread patterns invisible at normal viewing distance but engineered for precision grip.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep mahogany with warm undertones, allowing natural light to reveal rich burgundy-brown gradations. Minimal accent: thin leather welt in slightly darker shade, cream-colored stitching along brogue detailing.
physical_description.closures: Traditional lace closure with five eyelets per side, mahogany-toned synthetic laces threaded in standard crossover pattern. Option for magnetic hidden laces (Tier 1 variant) available.
distinctive_features: Hand-buffed leather finish that develops micro-patina over weeks of wear
Full-brogue perforation pattern across toe and quarters—both decorative and structural
Thin-profile sole barely visible from the side—emphasizes elegance over bulk
Micro-tread sole designed for corporate flooring, less visible on dark surfaces
Welt construction visible along the sole edge—signals handcrafted quality
Aldren & Moss subtle logo embossed on inner tongue and heel counter
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 luxury. The price point and craftsmanship signal old money or established corpo elite. Not flashy enough for nouveau riche displays, but expensive enough to exclude lower tiers.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by corporate administrators, medical professionals, established fixers with legitimate fronts, and aging street operators who've risen enough to invest in quality. The shoe says: 'I've been around long enough to know what lasts. I don't need to broadcast it.'
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine on purchase; develops a subtle patina and micro-scuffs within weeks. The mahogany finish actually improves with age, deepening and gaining character. Well-maintained examples from 5+ years ago are indistinguishable from new inventory to untrained eyes—a quality marker.
